CENSUS + ROOT CAUSE (release interp sweep of all 556 fixtures2/*.fz + behavior/*.fz at base 0cb890e95, timeout 120 each).

TIERS: TIMEOUT(124): 00277_enum_tier0_fixture, 00420_enum_take_drop_split, behavior/enum_take_drop_split. VIOLATION(>=0.5s, 20): enum_predicate_search 117.3s(fail), enum_map_family 36.2s, 00183_enum_take_list_range 8.3s(fail), 00419_enum_take_mixed 7.0s, 00230_enum_take_chained 7.0s, fz_f98_range_map_converges 6.0s, map_enumerable 5.6s, fz_f98_map_reduce 4.8s(fail), range_enumerable 3.1s, enum_tier0 2.9s(fail), 00418_enum_count_range 2.7s, membership_operator 2.2s, 00285_enum_sort_stable 2.0s, fz_f98_range_reduce_scalar 1.1s, 00280_enum_find_index 1.1s, 00279 0.95s(fail), enum_list_allocations 0.78s, fz_f98_range_reduce2 0.73s(fail), 00275 0.61s, enum_sort 0.54s. WATCH(0.1-0.5s): 45. COMPLIANT(<0.1s): 489. (143 fixtures fail with nonzero exit — counted separately, not this lane.)

DOMINANT MECHANISM (all of the violation tier except 00277): the transport component solve is a PER-ANCHOR GLOBAL RE-SOLVE. project_transport_component_product (src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs:741-900) expands the FULL executable closure from every anchor, rebuilds the whole ShapeConstraintGraph (project_one_executable over ALL executables :842-855, plus clause equalities/capture seeds/input constraints :856-858), solves the whole union (:860 build_union), computes component_shapes for ALL components (:870) — then keeps only the anchor's component and throws the rest away; record_transport_component (src/compiler2/pull.rs:825) memoizes under the anchor key only. Evidence: transport_component gap-sum/wall = 5.33/5.87s (range_map, 427 solves), 2.30/2.99s (range_enumerable, 492), 31.2/35.6s (map_family, 1205), 96.4/113.2s (predicate_search, 1785), 117.3/120s-cap (00420, 1113 solves at ~105ms each, still going). Per-solve cost is FLAT vs component size (size-1 costs the same ~15ms as size-9) and LINEAR in global executable count (12.5ms@60 execs -> 26ms@146 -> 54ms@272 -> ~105ms on 00420) => total O(components x global graph) = quadratic. identical=0, duplicate (kind,key)=0 for transport_component => pure volume x unit-cost, NOT churn/re-production. Cross-check of .18.12: TransportShape still 1x/position on the product path (664/1965/2658 productions, identical=0, ~0 gap) — no regression there; the cost is entirely the component solve.

UNIT-COST SUB-MECHANISM (~50% of per-solve time, sampled on 00420: 4101/8170 in-solve samples): sorting with type-FORMATTING comparators. executable_sort_key (transport.rs:1819) -> input_structure_key (:1815) renders every input Ty via types.display into Vec<String> per key; sort_by_key recomputes keys per comparison; outgoing_input_edge_waits (:938-952) sorts the ENTIRE executable set (comparator bottoms out in types::format::display) merely to emit waits in deterministic order, and is called every expansion iteration (:779, :810); same sort at :840-841, :961, :997.

SEPARATE MECHANISM — 00277_enum_tier0_fixture: telemetry goes silent at 0.30s, then >120s inside AnalyzeActivation. Stack sample (6606/6673): analyze_activation -> World::define_callsite_summary -> CallSiteMap::define -> Types::is_equivalent -> is_subtype -> Descr::is_empty_memo -> types::emptiness::tuple_clause_empty -> phi_tuple SELF-RECURSION (4+ frames deep) grinding Descr::diff/intersect/dnf_intersect allocations — an exponential tuple-emptiness blowup, not transport. Needs its own ticket.

FIX DIRECTION (keystone): solve once per settled executable closure and record ALL components/shapes/callable/boundary facts from that one solve (the solve at :870 already computes every component's shape — the code discards it); index the component memo by member position, not anchor-only. Expected recovery: range_map ~5.3s, map_family ~31s, predicate_search ~96s, 00420 >30min -> seconds. Secondary: structural (Ty-id) sort keys / sort_by_cached_key, and don't sort whole sets to collect waits. OVERLAPS: fz-go4.22 AOT-grind bucket IS this monolith (should collapse with the keystone); fz-go4.18.9 touches the same producer (sequence/coordinate); fz-go4.18.18 near-collapsed at this base as predicted (MaterializedExecutable identical 6/364, 7/683, 3/336).

Gate at base: cargo test --lib compiler2 = 931 passed / 0 failed in 109.53s (fits the 120s cap only when pre-built; the timed run must exclude compilation). Draft burn-down tickets in the agent report to the coordinator.
